reuse.why: Three of the five midpoint copies are replaced by calls to the existing exported getScheduledAmount, and the rule itself goes into one new shared getRangedScheduleAmount that getScheduledAmount also uses.

duplication.why: All five inline midpoint computations are removed; forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts still keep their own number-vs-range dispatch around getRangedScheduleAmount instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, where both client and server already take schedule amounts from.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, comments, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The worst-case rule is a single small function every path uses; the two remaining local dispatches are minor.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every ranged-amount site now reaches getRangedScheduleAmount, directly or via getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the old copies are removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getRangedScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount (schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, desktop-client) and directly by forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts.
